title: A/P Summary: a row shows one location's name or Multiple
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has open bills only at {Location-A}; Vendor {Vendor-B} has open bills at {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-05 One Place and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-05 Two Places.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location cell of {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B}.
  2. Untick {Location-B} in the Location menu (leaving {Location-A} and {Location-C}).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Vendor-A} shows {Location-A}'s name; {Vendor-B} shows "Multiple".
  • Step 2: the Location column stays (two locations ticked), and {Vendor-B}'s Location cell now shows {Location-A}'s name: only its documents at the chosen locations count, and they are all at {Location-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
